description: This file defines the ShippingOption class, which models shipping options in the system, including details like price, delivery dates, and identifiers.

classes.name: ShippingOption
classes.description: A Java class representing shipping options, including properties for price, name, code, delivery dates, and description.

methods.name: getOptionPrice
methods.description: Retrieves the shipping option's price, attempting to parse it from text if necessary.

methods.name: setOptionPriceText
methods.description: Sets the shipping option's price as text.

methods.name: getOptionPriceText
methods.description: Retrieves the shipping option's price as text.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description for the shipping option.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Retrieves the description of the shipping option.

methods.name: setEstimatedNumberOfDays
methods.description: Sets the estimated number of days for delivery.

methods.name: getEstimatedNumberOfDays
methods.description: Retrieves the estimated number of days for delivery.
